accepted_scope: CDC-harmonized A/B partial reconstruction: 36 recomputed M3/trend/interaction fits, changed laboratory summaries, and verified unchanged M1/M2 reuse.

methods: Every new M3/trend/interaction formula, domain, sample, case/control count, rank, design df, residual df and current data version checked
Every new coefficient and SE checked against lean vcov; OR, t-based CI and p, and separately labelled z comparator checked
Every joint interaction Wald F independently calculated from the interaction coefficient vector and covariance block; numerator rank, denominator df and F-tail p checked
Five selected harmonized M3/interaction fits independently reproduced using ordinary GLM score equations and independent stratum-centered PSU sandwich covariance
Changed creatinine and biochemical-profile triglyceride Table1 means and SEs independently reconstructed for both candidates and hypertension groups
All continuous primary-domain medians, filled values and missing indicators checked
All 60 reused M1/M2 lean artifacts match E1 byte hashes exactly; merged M1/M2 coefficient/count/trend numeric rows and row provenance agree with E1

omitted_columns_sidecar.explanation: Forty B-domain occurrences of sodium_missing/fat_missing are constant zero, twenty A fat_missing occurrences are linearly dependent, and thirty-six hdl_missing occurrences are linearly dependent. Saved rank, covariance and residual df already account for these omitted columns. This independent sidecar supplies the missing documentation.

visual_review.QC_units: Both original and backward-harmonized creatinine/TG axes are mg/dL; the dashed line is equality.

reporting_notes: Primary A n=21458 and dietary-weight B n=19925 remain distinct. Population, weighting and inclusion differences are part of their estimands; do not describe the comparison as a general superiority test.
Model1/2 lean objects retain E1 data-version fields because their input columns are unchanged. Exact artifact reuse and effective E2 lineage are documented by dependency and row-provenance sidecars.
The new repair computation records zero warnings. Historical E1 categorical approximation warnings still apply to reused outputs; do not claim all analyses were warning-free.
Use the independent omitted-column sidecar with the formula and sample/rank/df tables. Null/empty inherited alias fields do not mean no model-matrix columns were excluded.
The optional common-complete-case suite was not run and has no current output. No additional method or candidate was introduced by this audit.

E1 is an immutable raw-laboratory diagnostic; E2 is the primary CDC-harmonized revision of the same A/B candidates. The original authors' calibration, eligibility and missing-data choices remain unreported, so this is partial reconstruction.

BIOPRO LBXSTR remains distinct from reference fasting LBXTR. The fixed CDC bridging coefficients are treated as known in these regression calculations; the reported survey CIs cover sampling uncertainty under the specified analysis.
Cross-sectional odds ratios, ordinal trends and subgroup interactions describe associations. Do not label these odds ratios as risk ratios, prevalence ratios or causal effects.

exposure_record.record: Published values appeared during earlier source review. Current code and derived/model artifacts were read for fixed-definition numerical auditing. Initial learning notes have not yet been read.
exposure_record.tuning: None. The amendment follows official CDC assay documentation and mathematical verification.

scope_limits: The separate data audit covers all raw/source rows, calibration transformations, unchanged columns and every manifest entry; those checks are not duplicated here.
This decision concerns the exact pinned computational artifacts. Final learning-note text, tables, links and figure references require their own exact-version document QA.
